notes.title: particles and lights
notes.notes: Now Adventure's Pixel World has particles that come out of gun shots and when there is an impact with an object, in addition to lights in the levels. Thanks for playing! Much content will be added and improved.

notes.title: Particles and lights added
notes.notes: The game now contains particles when firing weapons and impacting objects, as well as ambient lights. Thanks for playing Adventure's Pixel World, more content will be added soon!
